profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, traded under the ticker ZBRA. Its site describes it as a foundation for intelligent operations, saying it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes using mobile computers, scanners, printers, and RFID. It also markets manufacturing technology solutions combining hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

On the AI side, the company describes AI software solutions aimed at frontline operations, which it says optimize workflows, streamline processes, and simplify tasks. Named offerings include Zebra Companion AI for tailored insights and support, Frontline AI Enablers consisting of AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs, and Frontline AI Blueprints, which the company describes as adaptable frameworks that automate manual tasks. The Aurora suite of machine vision software covers track-and-trace, vision inspection, and industrial automation, and Aurora Focus is presented as an interface for setting up and running fixed industrial scanners and machine vision smart cameras. Zebra describes its AI as an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

The company's litigation record shows 374 cases in Illinois. No lawsuits, tracked products, or MCP servers are listed for it.
